verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on Pinecone itself offering user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs, triggers, or autonomous background workflows. Backups are documented only as actions you initiate through the SDK, API, or console, with no recurring schedule, so a one-off action does not count as a recurring automation. The MCP server and agent integrations let external agents drive Pinecone, which is adjacent client-driven tooling rather than the product running automations itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
